correctness.rationale: For m>=3 three-edge branched theta graph, the Abrams ordered-particle two-cube model has cell counts c0=4m²+6m+2, c1=12m², c2=7m²-5m. Connectivity uses a third free branch; any 2-cycle in the ordered model has coefficients constant across edge pairs of given branches by the two separate tensor partial boundaries, and shared pole forbids first-edge pairs for every i,j, forcing zero, with transfer proving H2 of unordered quotient also zero. Its signed Lefschetz fixed-cell table for branch permutation sigma, pole rho and label tau gives character (-1)^h(f(f-1)-1) for no particle swap or (-1)^h(1-2t) with swap, since H0 is trivial. Directed-pair module W/Q(sum e_ij) has exactly that character; rational semisimplicity and tau-invariants give unordered Λ²Q^m with pole sign. Fresh independent cubical signed-trace calculations confirmed all cases m=3,4, and universal proof handles arbitrary m. Check excludes m=2 where configuration disconnected.

General graph-braid generator literature and published three-particle theta-class modules are different homological objects. A prior general graph-braid character theorem may potentially imply this particular representation, but none was found/verified in inspected sources.
